method: Normal read-only Codex in-app browser navigation and visible document text. These are paraphrased review observations, not archived original HTML.

observations.section: Note 12, Net Earnings per Share, page 104
observations.finding: The 2022 basic and diluted common EPS numerator is loss available to Whirlpool of $1,519 million. Basic denominator 55.9 million shares. Prior years shown separately.
2022 consolidated earnings $2,726 million less $9 million NCI earnings equals $2,717 million attributable to Mondelez, used with 1,378 million basic common shares.

observations.section: Significant accounting policies, Earnings Per Share; Note 22
observations.finding: The accounting policy explicitly defines basic EPS using net income divided by weighted-average common shares. Note 22 shows fiscal 2023 income of $118.584 million and 387.763 million basic common shares.

observations.section: Significant accounting policies, Earnings (Loss) Per Share
observations.finding: The accounting policy explicitly defines basic EPS using total net income or loss divided by weighted-average common shares. The continuing-operations EPS footnote alone is insufficient for total common earnings. Current statement comparatives and total basic EPS were separately reviewed.

observations.section: Balance sheet page 3 and statements of shareholder equity pages 4-5
observations.finding: The parent equity columns include a $7.878 million deferred compensation obligation alongside common stock, paid-in capital, retained earnings, treasury stock and AOCI. They reconcile to $1,874.107 million parent equity; $39.184 million NCI is separately presented.
